name: agentic_resume_tailoring
description: Resume tailoring on a per-user knowledge graph — GraphRAG retrieval, a two-agent planner loop, and a composite reward with a faithfulness check.

paragraphs: Tailor your resume to a job posting with the coding agent you already use.

ARTie is a local toolkit that Claude Code or Codex drives through tools (MCP, and a JSON CLI). Your agent's model does the reading and writing. ART keeps what a model should not own: a skills knowledge graph of your real experience with the evidence behind each claim, a library of bullets you have approved, your standing preferences, and every tailored version as a node in a history you can revert. Each change a host proposes passes hard gates before it is committed (every bullet cites evidence in your graph, numbers and entities match, banned topics stay out, the page fits on one), and a…
